title: Growth-brain and persona-review cron results are never delivered ('unknown platform webui')
evidence: cron/jobs.json: tc-growth-harness-brain (43b0d5c4446d, hourly) and tc-weekly-persona-review (8d3ac21799d5, Mon 09:00) both report last_status=delivery_failed. The overnight watchdog logged the same thing twice: "result not delivered — unknown platform 'webui'". Every hourly growth report and the weekly persona review are therefore written to disk and thrown away.

notes.note: Ops-triage 2026-09-19 20:2x UTC: unchanged, blocked on Tim naming a delivery destination. Confirmed again this run -- this job's own report is in the same boat (last_status=delivery_failed, unknown platform webui). Run output still lands in cron/output/<job-id>/*.md, so continuity is intact; local would only mask the failure and bot-chat changes spend. No action taken (Hermes config, outside this repo).

2026-09-19 21:3x UTC ops-triage re-verified. Still broken and now confirmed mechanically: gateway/config.py Platform has 25 members (LOCAL, TELEGRAM, DISCORD, ... EMAIL, HOMEASSISTANT, ...) and NO webui member, so deliver=origin with origin.platform=webui can never resolve -- the report is written to cron/output/<job-id>/*.md and then dropped. jobs.json: tc-growth-harness-brain (hourly) and tc-weekly-persona-review (Mon 09:00) both last_status=delivery_failed, and tc-ops-triage (this fix loop) is in the same state -- verified last_status=delivery_failed, last_delivery_error unknown platform webui, last run 17:05. So this loop own reports are discarded too; the board under ops/board/ is the only durable record of what it found. The ONE job that reports ok is tc-overnight-watchdog, which uses deliver=local -- that flips the status to ok while still delivering nothing to Tim, so it hides the failure rather than fixing it and is rejected as a fix. channel_directory.json lists homeassistant and email with EMPTY channel lists and config.yaml has no platforms block, so this profile currently has no messaging destination at all. BLOCKED ON TIM: name a destination (add an email/telegram channel, or accept bot-chat knowing each delivery injects the report as a message the bot answers = an extra agent turn per hour). Fix is one command per job once named, e.g. hermes cron edit 43b0d5c4446d --deliver <target>, plus a gateway restart to pick up jobs.json.

Re-verified 2026-09-19 23:5xZ against ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json: ALL FOUR turbo-carnival jobs fail delivery -- tc-growth-harness-brain (deliver=origin, last_status=delivery_failed), tc-weekly-persona-review (origin, delivery_failed), tc-ops-triage (origin, delivery_failed), tc-overnight-watchdog (deliver=local, last_status=ok 16:01). So the failure is exactly deliver=origin resolving to platform 'webui', which the gateway cannot deliver to, while 'local' succeeds. One-line fix per job: hermes cron edit <id> --deliver <target> with a target the gateway serves (local writes the report to the profile cron/output/, where it is already being read; telegram or similar if Tim wants a push). NOT ACTIONED: cron config is outside this repo and the destination is Tim's call -- note this run's own report is subject to the same failure, which is why it is escalated instead of worked around.

Needs Tim to name a delivery target (Hermes config, outside this repo).

Re-verified 2026-09-20 01:30Z from ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json: tc-growth-harness-brain, tc-weekly-persona-review AND tc-ops-triage all carry last_status=delivery_failed (deliver=origin -> platform 'webui' unknown), while tc-overnight-watchdog is last_status=ok with deliver=local. This is now the TOP blocker of the whole ops loop: the triage run's own findings -- including every item in this file -- are written to cron/output/<id>/*.md and never delivered, so the only durable channel is this board plus the repo commits. One-line fix per job (set deliver=local, or repair the webui target), but the destination is Tim's call, so it stays open.
